heading: Preemption

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: No State shall have authority to—

children.text: conduct an investigation into an electronic communication service provider’s alleged assistance to an element of the intelligence community;
require through regulation or any other means the disclosure of information about an electronic communication service provider’s alleged assistance to an element of the intelligence community;
impose any administrative sanction on an electronic communication service provider for assistance to an element of the intelligence community; or

commence or maintain a civil action or other proceeding to enforce a requirement that an electronic communication service provider disclose information concerning alleged assistance to an element of the intelligence community.

tree.heading: Suits by the United States
tree.text: The United States may bring suit to enforce the provisions of this section.

tree.heading: Jurisdiction
tree.text: The district courts of the United States shall have jurisdiction over any civil action brought by the United States to enforce the provisions of this section.

tree.heading: Application
tree.text: This section shall apply to any investigation, action, or proceeding that is pending on or commenced after July 10, 2008.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 95–511, title VIII, § 803, as added Pub. L. 110–261, title II, § 201, July 10, 2008, 122 Stat. 2470.)
